title: Learner profile — ai_preferences.interaction_preferences.learning
description: Schema for the /cse:learn learner profile. Stored at the JSONB path interaction_preferences.learning on the user's existing ai_preferences row with scope='user' — portable across orgs and devices, read and written exclusively via the cascade_sync_ai_preferences MCP tool (get to load, set with the FULL merged interaction_preferences object to persist — sibling keys such as aliases must never be dropped). NO migration is required: this is just a new key inside the existing interaction_preferences JSONB column. Org-level defaults are possible via the existing scope='org' ai_preferences row at the same path; user-scoped values always win over org defaults when both exist.

depth_default.description: The learner's default lesson depth when a request doesn't specify one. 'overview' = quick primer / mental model only; 'working-knowledge' = enough to use the thing competently; 'deep-dive' = internals, trade-offs, and failure modes. Phase 1 calibration may override this per topic.

background.description: Short free-text descriptors of who the learner is and what they already bring — role, technical depth, home domains (e.g. 'full-stack TypeScript', 'founder/CEO', 'ex-data-engineering'). Lessons calibrate vocabulary and starting altitude from this; it is descriptive, not an enum.

formats.description: Preferred teaching formats, in rough priority order. 'code-first' leads with runnable examples; 'analogies' leads with the mental model; 'exercises' appends try-it-yourself steps. Generation honors the top formats without excluding the others.

comfort_notes.description: Free text capturing how the learner wants unknowns and jargon handled when a lesson hits territory they likely don't know — e.g. 'stop and explain new acronyms inline', 'footnote unknowns, keep the pace', 'assume competence, I will ask'. Written from the Phase 0 interview's handling-unknowns dimension.

topics_known.description: Map from canonical topic_slug (lowercase-hyphenated, the same slug used in lesson artifacts' type_data.topic_slug) to the learner's self-assessed level. Lessons skip or compress territory marked 'proficient'/'expert' and start colder on 'none'. Updated as lessons are generated and as the learner reveals knowledge mid-session.

additionalProperties.description: Self-assessed knowledge level for this topic_slug.

examples.comfort_notes: Footnote unfamiliar acronyms inline but keep the pace; never re-explain git or SQL basics.
